title: GSK1070806 Phase 2b · 219538
design: Randomized, placebo-controlled, dose-ranging; biologic-naive and biologic-experienced groups; 2:1:1:1:2 randomization
population_summary: Adults (≥18 years) with moderate-to-severe AtD for at least 1 year, EASI ≥16, IGA ≥3, BSA ≥10%

endpoints.label: Percent change from baseline (PCFB) in the EASI to Week 16

endpoints.label: PCFB in the EASI at each time point (longitudinal dose-response)

criteria.text: Eligible adult participants (≥18 years of age) with moderate-to-severe AtD for at least 1 year, as defined by the AAD Consensus Criteria, with an EASI Score of ≥16, an IGA score of ≥3 and a BSA of ≥10%.
